name: KAYTHEBOSS
description: KAYTHEBOSS is a graphic design studio in Berlin and New York. We design labels, posters, visual identities and websites that people notice — and that make your business easier to choose.

disciplines.title: Labels and Posters
disciplines.body: Labels and posters that catch the eye from across the room, and still hold up close up.

disciplines.title: Visual Identity Design
disciplines.body: A logo and a look that people recognise, plus simple rules so your team can use it correctly.

disciplines.title: Websites & Apps
disciplines.body: Websites and app screens that load quickly, are easy to use, and look the way you intended.
points: Design that works on every screen size
